approvedDesignText:
Add repeatable `--field <name>` and repeatable `--field-id <id>` to `gh project item-list`, with help showing `gh project item-list 1 --owner "@me" --field Status --field "Target date"`. The selection forms are mutually exclusive. A selection form also conflicts explicitly with every formatting/output flag this command supports: `--format`, `--jq`/`-q`, and `--template`/`-t`. These conflicts are reported by selection validation before generic formatter validation can produce an unrelated error.

The normal item-list request fetches its first field page. When selection is requested and that connection has more pages, fetch every remaining page from the returned cursor before resolving or rendering, appending it to the original response without re-fetching the first page. If retrieval fails, return a useful wrapped error and print no table. Without selection, never fetch further field pages.

Resolve names case-insensitively and IDs exactly across the complete field set. Preserve supplied order and duplicate selections. Unknown names list sorted field-name candidates; unknown IDs list sorted `name (id)` candidates; ambiguous names list sorted matching IDs. All validation errors occur before rendering.

Append selected columns after the existing five columns, headed by the resolved field names. Map each value to a selected column only via its field ID. Unset and unknown values are blank. Render date/text/single-select as text; numbers with `FormatFloat(..., 'f', -1, 64)`-equivalent compact decimal output with no forced trailing zeros; iterations and milestones by title; labels, users, reviewers, and pull requests as comma-and-space joined lists (label names, user logins, reviewer user logins or team names, and pull-request URLs respectively); repositories as URLs. Normalize all table-cell text by deleting carriage returns and replacing every newline with a space.

With neither selection flag, preserve all current behavior: existing table output and formatted output remain unchanged, as do `--limit`, `--query`, no-results handling, and host-capability checks. The only exceptions are the documented selection/output conflicts. Test command/help/each explicit formatting conflict; name/ID resolution and deterministic errors; duplicate ordering; field-ID mapping; all value formats and normalization; pagination success/failure with no partial output; no additional field-page request without selection; and compatibility for existing formatted, limit, query, no-results, and feature-capability paths.
